topic: NENHUM DIREITO A MENOS. NENHUM PASSO ATRÁS. Geledés Brasil
insights: President Dilma Rousseff emphasized the importance of not regressing on social rights during her inauguration speech.
She committed to maintaining social programs and making economic adjustments without reversing previous gains.
Rousseff's agenda for her second term included a focus on education and political reform.

quotes.text: Nós vamos fazer, sim, ajustes na economia mas isso sem revogar direitos conquistados ou trair nossos compromissos sociais.
Assumo meu compromisso de inaugurar uma nova etapa nesse processo de mudanças sociais no Brasil.

summary: President Dilma Rousseff's inauguration speech highlighted her commitment to advancing social rights and maintaining existing social programs while making necessary economic adjustments. This pledge, encapsulated in the phrase 'nenhum direito a menos, nenhum passo atrás,' set the tone for her second term agenda focused on social change and political reform.

signal.title: NENHUM DIREITO A MENOS. NENHUM PASSO ATRÁS.
